listings.description:
You won't believe the size of this newly renovated 1-bedroom apartment, located in a quiet street in Kedron! With the bus stop and local Coles supermarket just a short walk away, you won't even need a car!

This is Rooming Accommodation & is suitable for one resident only.

Live here and you'll love:
- Open plan living area with air conditioning
- Kitchen with convection microwave and fridge provided (not pictured)
- Large bedroom with ceiling fan
- Modern bathroom with large shower
- Electricity, water & NBN invoiced directly at fixed cost of $70 per month 
- Communal laundry fitted with 2 washing machines and 2 clothes dryers
- Off-street parking available (non allocated)

** PLEASE READ CAREFULLY **
* To arrange an inspection click GET IN TOUCH and submit your details.
* To apply online, copy & paste this link into your browser https://app.snug.com/apply/ljhookerstafford . We do not accept 2Apply or Ignite applications.
* To apply on paper, you can complete an RTA Form 22 Rental Application via Snug or our office.
* Open Homes are usually on Saturdays and the time will be published as soon as confirmed.  Pre-registration via Snug is encouraged and can be completed at  https://app.snug.com/apply/ljhookerstafford .
* In preparing this information, we have used our best endeavours to ensure that the information is true and accurate however we accept no responsibility and disclaim all liability in respect of any errors, inaccuracies, or misstatements. Prospective tenants should make their own inquiries to verify the information provided which is provided as a convenience to clients.
